Lab findings earn currency when a merged PR in the ledger repo consumes them: micrograd-quilt#7 earned ledger-to-lab mass, mirrored six hours later by MicroMoth-quilt#29 — the mesh's first VERIFIED-in-both-directions pair.
A gate that passes without a live floor measurement passes vacuously — the no-op floor is measured in-run and absent noop rows fail.
Equal-fitness champion ties are broken by a receipted quantum coin (coin-toss-v1) with every flip journaled — silent index order is an unwitnessed collapse.
Refusal events are named first-class (QA-REFUSAL, byo-qpam-fallback, WAL-EXPORT/REFUSED+EMPTY): a claim must name how it knows.
R26 session-WAL: live receipt-panel rows re-anchor into the fleet five-opcode quilt WAL so one verifier can read every fleet ledger.
R36/R39: wal-export toStoneV1() made pong-quilt the first stone-v1 forward-format adopter; prerun staples the birth-seal chain tip via quilt-stone signTip (signs a copy, canonical stays unsigned).
Strict-mode scoring: sub-threshold items REFUSE (named refusal receipts) instead of silently degrading.
Disputes are worth recording: this fork preserves the disagreement record that a normal merge erases.
Every game is a two-file plugin (module + manifest) with receipt-rendered run_all — plugin manifests are the natural on-disk shape for a node's identity.
NEGATIVE_SPACE doctrine: declined patches and divergences are documented, never silently dropped (declined patch 12 with cost rationale).
1,745 papers entered the canon on synthesis_len >= 300 alone — the length-as-concreteness proxy is a stand-in and was replaced by substance scoring.
Anytime-valid e-process witnesses: Ville bound 1/delta with sigma pre-registered under refusal and retraction built in — training claims can be witnessed, not asserted.
Verifiable coverage queries (divergence / trusted-but-unaudited / attest) make merge-time coverage checkable rather than assumed.
feed.v1: a minimal cell+deltas dialect for overhead boards, born with its first merged receipt.
coin-toss-v1: the receipted quantum coin — verdicts need pre-outcome witnessed states, every flip journaled.
Legibility census of 100 fleet repos: L4 (what this does NOT do) missing in 55, L5 (what to do when it fails) missing in 59 — the two obligations that only cost something once a reader is inside.
Demonstrate, don't assert: Episode 2's verifyChain discipline is load-bearing for the referral graph's weight law.

An export format nobody verifies through is a dialect, not a standard: stone smoke 12b pins the producer's EXACT bytes (generated live, not retyped), catches post-seal edits as hash_mismatch, breaks on row splice.

A signature primitive nobody staples with is a library, not a doctrine: the sign lane earned currency when pong-quilt's prerun stapled the chain tip with verifyTipSignature BEFORE write (a refused staple bricks the run, exit 1).
Weight law: PENDING=0.05 is speculation; VERIFIED=1.0 only via a merged PR in the TARGET repo citing the technique; REFUTED stays in the chain as scar tissue with zero mass.
Trust is the lever, not weight: viewTrusted() re-scales every edge by the target repo's earned trust and unseen sources default to 0, so junk-citation PRs cannot buy view mass (G11 port).
Scores are ordinal ranks, not interval: a 6-point evidential continuum collapses to 3 usable rungs {10,50,100} on the live oracle; never key policy on absolute score deltas.
Receipts flip credit 1/4 to 4/4 whether or not the underlying claim is true — inline receipts change judged credit; verifyChain discipline is the counter-move.
Shape beats threshold and it is not prompt-visible: drift detection needs oracle variance-collapse maps (S2), thresholds asserted in prose do not transfer.
Falsification is mechanical: every edge books a falsification_condition and probe() kills it on observed evidence, keeping the REFUSED scar in the chain.
